long_biography.plain_text:
Before launching his own firm, Orr directed a pioneering investment service in Debenhams department stores. He and Paul Killik then opened a Chelsea branch designed as a local, approachable alternative to City stockbrokers. Orr guided the partnership for seventeen years, cultivating private clients through community offices and an emphasis on accessible advice.

That concern with overlooked investors informed his charitable work. With Claire Mackintosh, Orr created a practical route for donating tiny or illiquid equity holdings whose sale costs exceeded their value. He remained a trustee until 2012. More recently, he has backed projects spanning clean energy, education, health and life sciences, while funding visual-literacy research in schools with his wife, Sybil Robson Orr.
